none: PAS FindID 893203: Roman copper alloy nummus of Valens
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman copper alloy nummus of Valens dating from c.AD 364 to 378 (Reece Period 19). Reverse type SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE Victory advancing left, holding palm branch and wreath. Cf Roman Imperial Coinage IX Arelate. Minted in Arles. The diameter is 17mm and the weight 1.68g. Obverse diademed, draped, cuirassed bust, right, inscription D N VALEN-S P F AVG. Reverse inscription SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE.…
